content: For MDX-based blog/case studies in Next.js in 2026, options are: (1) next-mdx-remote (6.0.0) for simple file-based MDX loaded at runtime/build, (2) Velite (0.4.0) for schema-validated content collections with generated TS types, (3) Fumadocs for full docs-site frameworks (overkill for a portfolio). For a small number of case studies + blog posts, next-mdx-remote or a minimal Velite setup is standard; a headless CMS is unnecessary at this content volume.
